mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate over the past 3 months, indicating a rapidly tightening labor market, will lead to wage inflation and reduced corporate profitability, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops >0.5pp in 3mo but SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth slows by more than 2% YoY, signaling a potential supply chain disruption or weakening manufacturing sector, S&P 500 returns tend to be negative over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: YoY INDPRO growth slows by >2% but SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 3%, indicating a restrictive monetary policy stance, S&P 500 returns tend to be negative over the next 60 trading days as higher borrowing costs weigh on economic activity.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 3% but SPX 60-day returns are positive in >50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts growth accelerates by more than 10% YoY, signaling a strong residential construction sector, S&P 500 returns tend to be positive over the next 20 trading days as the housing boom boosts economic activity.
failure_condition: YoY HOUST growth > 10% but SPX 20-day returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth slows by more than 100,000 jobs per month over a 3-month period, signaling a weakening labor market, S&P 500 returns tend to be negative over the next 60 trading days as the economy potentially enters a recession.
failure_condition: 3mo avg PAYEMS growth < -100k jobs/mo but SPX 60-day returns are positive in >45% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (PCE) growth slows by more than 2% YoY, signaling a weakening consumer sector, S&P 500 returns tend to be negative over the next 20 trading days as the economy potentially enters a recession.
failure_condition: YoY RSAFS growth slows by >2% but SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate rises above 3%, indicating a potential inflationary spiral, and the federal funds rate is below 2%, signaling accommodative monetary policy, S&P 500 returns tend to be negative over the next 60 trading days as the Fed may need to aggressively raise rates to combat inflation.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3% and FEDFUNDS < 2% but SPX 60-day returns are positive in >50% of triggered instances.
